result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and vehicle traffic signals, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands. Dense vegetation on the corner may obstruct sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The absence of pedestrian-specific signals at a signalized intersection forces pedestrians to rely on vehicle lights, which may not provide sufficient crossing time.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
